outgoing.name: California
outgoing.excerpt: A resolution introduced by some members of the California state assembly light-heartedly denounces the IAU for "scientific heresy," among other crimes.

outgoing.name: Chinese language
outgoing.excerpt: In the Chinese, Japanese, and Korean languages, the name was translated as death king star (冥王星), suggested by Houei Nojiri in 1930.

outgoing.name: England
outgoing.excerpt: The name Pluto was first suggested by Venetia Burney (later Venetia Phair), at the time an eleven-year-old girl from Oxford, England.

outgoing.name: Zeus
outgoing.excerpt: Constance Lowell, Percival Lowell's widow, proposed Zeus, then Lowell, and finally her own first name, none of which met with any enthusiasm.
